newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Family Entertainment forms partnership.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Family Entertainment forms partnership.

text.p: International Family Entertainment Inc and United International Holdings Inc said Wednesday they had formed a joint partnership to launch three cable channels in Latin America next year.

The partnership, to be called United Family Communications and based in Miami, will launch The Family Channel, Atlas and Casa Club TV on March 24, airing new and internationally acquired products in Spanish and Portuguese.

"We expect this partnership to open new international opportunities for International Family Entertainment," the company said. "As an international MSO, United International Holdings joins the venture with established overseas resources in the cable business."
